question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3
solution:
The correct answer is '**grumpy**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The passage discusses how appearances can be deceptive.
 
• It mentions people who seem pleasant on the outside can often be the opposite.
 
• "**Grumpy**" works well in contrast to smiling, suggesting such people are actually unpleasant.
 
• Other options ("**ecstatic**", "**joyful**", "**sparkling**") do not convey this negative contrast.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**grumpy**'.

 

Complete Passage: * Appearances may not reveal the man. So, you shouldn't make judgments about a man's character based on how he looks__. People smile and smile, yet prove to be __grumpy__. On the other hand, people with rough exteriors prove to be the __kindest__ and most considerate people on earth. They are the people who are beautiful from __within__. * 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** __Additional Information__ ** 

 
• Ecstatic (प्रसन्न): "Ecstatic" means feeling or expressing overwhelming happiness, which does not fit the negative contrast needed here.
 
• Joyful (खुश): "Joyful" means feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure and happiness, which does not fit the context of being deceitful.
 
• Sparkling (स्पार्कलिंग): "Sparkling" means shining brightly with flashes of light, metaphorically meaning lively or witty, which is not contextually appropriate.
